item.title: Debugging a WAF in Front of Scaleway Serverless Containers
item.description: How I configured and debugged host-based routing, upstream TLS, and redirects between a public WAF and an IAM-private Scaleway Serverless Container.

item.title: Before ChatGPT: What My Master's Thesis Taught Me About Meaning in Text
item.description: A look back at my 2021 master’s thesis on Gaussian LDA, word embeddings, and the surprisingly difficult question of whether a topic model has understood anything.

item.title: Adding Shapes: My Bachelor Thesis on Minkowski Sums
item.description: A practical tour of the algorithm behind my 2019 bachelor thesis: extracting the Minkowski sum of two simple polygons from their convolution.
